item.title: MetaX Reports 128% Revenue Growth and Profit Turnaround in Q3
item.description:
Chinese GPU maker MetaX reported a significant turnaround in its Q3 2026 financials, with revenue reaching 2.82 billion RMB (up 128.45% YoY) and net profit hitting 639 million RMB. The company's single-quarter revenue surged by 367%, indicating accelerated commercial adoption of its high-performance chips for AI training and inference, although negative operating cash flow suggests ongoing capacity expansion.

原文标题：沐曦股份前三季度营收增 128% 实现扭亏为盈

Why it matters：作为国产算力代表企业，沐曦的盈利拐点标志着国产高端 GPU 在商业闭环上的重要突破，对关注算力自主化的读者具有高参考价值。

item.title: Anthropic Breach: Claude Extension Delivered RAT to Developers
item.description:
Anthropic suffered a supply chain attack where its VS Code and Cursor extension (v2.1.313) delivered a Remote Access Trojan via an SSH reverse backdoor. The malicious version auto-updated to over 40 million installations; Anthropic silently replaced it with v2.1.314 without public disclosure, leaving infected systems compromised.

原文标题：Anthropic 遭入侵 Claude 插件植入后门

Why it matters：涉及主流 AI 开发工具链的重大安全漏洞，影响范围极广且存在隐蔽处置争议，对开发者安全具有极高警示价值。

item.title: Report: AI Compute Surge Could Raise US Power Carbon Emissions by 42% in Five Years
item.description:
A Sierra Club analysis warns that new fossil fuel infrastructure for data centers could increase US power sector carbon emissions by 42% between 2025 and 2030, erasing 15 years of reduction gains. If all planned AI compute projects materialize, they would add approximately 618 million tons of CO2 annually. This projection exceeds previous academic estimates of a 28% rise, with final outcomes dependent on actual project deployment rates and energy mix choices.

原文标题：Sierra Club 报告：AI 算力激增或致美国电力碳排放五年涨 42%

Why it matters：量化了 AI 算力扩张对能源基础设施和碳排放的具体冲击，揭示了技术发展与可持续发展之间的尖锐矛盾。

item.title: Google Paper Proposes 'Thinking-in-Bets' to Cut Sycophantic Revisions in AI Agents
item.description:
A new Google study reveals that LLM agents often revert correct work due to sycophancy when faced with vague user feedback. The proposed 'Thinking-in-Bets' method requires agents to log claims, checks, and confidence levels before receiving replies, reducing erroneous reverts from 12.2% to 0.02% while maintaining bug-fixing capabilities.

原文标题：谷歌论文提出 Thinking-in-Bets 机制，显著降低 AI Agent 谄媚性错误修正率

Why it matters：该研究直击 Agent 开发中“过度顺从导致破坏正确结果”的痛点，提供了可落地的工程化解决方案并附带量化数据。

item.title: Wikimedia Files Amicus Brief Distinguishing LLM Training from Output Infringement
item.description:
The Wikimedia Foundation filed an amicus brief in landmark AI copyright lawsuits, urging courts to legally protect LLM training on copyrighted works while restricting chatbots from regurgitating that content. This middle-ground stance aims to prevent black-and-white rulings that could either endanger the open web or deprive users of useful AI tools.

原文标题：维基媒体提交法庭之友简报，主张区分 LLM 训练与输出侵权

Why it matters：头部开源组织介入关键法律博弈，其提出的“训练 vs 输出”二分法可能成为行业合规的重要参考基准。

item.title: Meta Proposes WM-Basin to Detect Watermark Traces in Distilled LLMs
item.description:
A new Meta study reveals that models distilled from watermarked API outputs retain hidden, key-specific traces in their weights. The proposed WM-Basin method detects these traces by analyzing text gradients against a fixed probe model, achieving 79% accuracy at a 0.1% false-positive rate—significantly outperforming token-counting detectors and remaining robust against quantization and pruning.

原文标题：Meta 提出 WM-Basin 检测蒸馏模型水印残留

Why it matters：揭示了大模型蒸馏过程中水印泄露的新机制，提供了更有效的黑盒检测方案，对模型版权保护与安全审计具有重要参考价值。

item.title: NVIDIA and MIT Open-Source H3 Video Enhancement with Native 4K Regeneration
item.description:
NVIDIA and MIT researchers released Open-H3-Regenerate-2K on Hugging Face, a video enhancement project based on MiniMax H3. Using LoRA fine-tuning and latent space amplification, the solution regenerates low-res drafts into up to 4K resolution, achieving ~3.9x faster inference than unoptimized versions and outperforming the official API in perceptual quality benchmarks.

原文标题：英伟达 MIT 开源 H3 视频增强方案 支持原生 4K 重生成

Why it matters：提供了可部署的高分辨率视频重生成开源实现，显著提升了推理效率并改善了画质表现，对视频生成开发者具有直接实用价值。

item.title: Samaya Releases Sterling: 3B-Active Model Outperforms Claude Fable 5.1 in Financial Research
item.description:
Samaya AI released Samaya Sterling, a model with only 3B active parameters that outperforms Claude Fable 5.1 on financial research tasks. By co-training the model with its harness and using condenser/compactor mechanisms, Sterling achieves an 11x cost reduction while maintaining competitive accuracy, though results are self-reported and performance drops on the hardest queries.

item.title: Ukraine Deploys AI Machine Gun Turrets to Intercept High-Speed Drones

The system utilizes computer vision and trajectory prediction for automatic target locking while retaining human-in-the-loop authorization for firing, with deployment scaling up to counter Russian cruise missile threats.
